newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jinwei to offer cash dividend.
newsitem.headline: Jinwei to offer cash dividend.

text.p: Jinwei Textile Machinery Co Ltd on Wednesday said it would offer a cash dividend of 0.04 yuan per share based on 1996 profits.
Shareholders approved the plan at an annual general meeting on Tuesday, the company said in a statement in Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
Holders of the firm's H shares will receive HK$0.0373 per share at an exchange rate of 1.07168 yuan to the Hong Kong dollar, and the H share dividend will be issued on June 26, the statement said.
The company earlier posted a net profit of 77.58 million yuan for 1996 against 68.76 million yuan for 1995 under international accounting standards.
